title: C4OS Grill Question 044 - Plugin SVG Icon Constraints

questions.label: Where can plugin SVG icons come from?
questions.help: Recommended: only from the installed plugin bundle assets directory, referenced by relative path from agents/c4os.yaml.
options: Installed plugin bundle assets only, referenced by relative path

questions.label: What SVG content should C4OS allow for plugin icons?
questions.help: Recommended: static sanitized SVG only. Disallow scripts, external references, event handlers, foreignObject, animation, and embedded raster/data URLs.
options: Static sanitized SVG only; no scripts, external refs, event handlers, foreignObject, animation, or embedded data
Plugin manifest declares what is allowed

questions.label: How should plugin icons render in the shell?
questions.help: Recommended: render in fixed-size icon slots with fallback icon on load/sanitize failure so header layout stays stable.
options: Fixed-size icon slots with fallback icon on failure
Render plugin name text instead of icon

questions.label: Should plugin SVG icons be themeable by C4OS?
questions.help: Recommended: preserve author colors by default, but allow monochrome mask mode if the plugin declares it.
options: Preserve author colors; allow declared monochrome mask mode

questions.label: Notes or corrections
questions.help: Clarify size requirements, dark/light mode behavior, accessibility labels, marketplace validation, or fallback icon choice.
